snippet.title: Japanese House Flipping | House Flipper 2 Sakura DLC Teaser
snippet.description:
Coming soon! Celebrate the sakura blossoms all year long on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4351410/House_Flipper_2__Sakura_DLC
- 5 jobs ranging from cozy tearoom to abandoned primary school,
- 5 characteristic Japanese houses to renovate,
- 5 new buyers interested in traditional Japanese architecture,
- 300+ Japan-themed items, including furniture, plants, decorations, and more,
- A Japanese countryside environment with a springtime Mt. Fuji view,
- New collectibles to look out for,
- 3 intricate wooden assemblies,
…and surprising new achievements!

Become a member of our House Flipper Discord Community:
https://discord.gg/QncyKz9V3H

Stay updated about House Flipper's development,
Chat, ask questions and share your houses with other players,
Hang out with the developers!

Social media channels:
X: https://twitter.com/houseflippersim
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/HouseFlipperGame
Twitch.tv: https://www.twitch.tv/frozen_district

🎼 Listen to the official HF2 soundtrack on Spotify:
https://open.spotify.com/album/6sYYatW5KxQI2nK1MflUBN
